en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of an ornate stone or plaster relief mounted on an exterior wall. The relief contains multiple biblical scenes, depicted in highly detailed bas-relief panels with elaborate swirling and floral Baroque decorations surrounding them. The uppermost panel depicts a group scene, likely a biblical event. The middle and largest panel shows a reclining central figure surrounded by others, which could represent the Lamentation of Christ or a similar Christian scene. The bottom panel shows a Crucifixion scene with figures below the cross. There is hand-written text at the top of the image, possibly numbering or labeling the postcard, but it is not in a modern printed typeface.
